resolved_finding.original_issue: Absent from any retained text could mean a quote must occur in all retained versions, whereas existing evaluator accepts at least one text per cited URL.
resolved_finding.resolution: Final text: for any cited URL, a quote occurring in none of that URL's retained original texts. This matches the existing citation_metrics implementation; no scoring change.

measurement_checks.manual_counts: Existing manual_metrics accepts arbitrary nonnegative integer or null values and requires cited evidence; added conditional counts are compatible.
measurement_checks.automatic_ratios: Existing metric and aggregation paths accept finite numeric ratios.
measurement_checks.aggregation: All-metric union, per-arm defined counts/mean/min/max/range, frozen-minus-base delta, strict abs(delta)>spread, N/A retained.

qualifications: Initial independent content/binding review and the S4 wording request occurred before prediction commit and B launch; this durable final receipt is written after B began. It is not a claim that this file existed before launch.
This is prospective for this new cohort, not blind: previous superseded outcomes were already known. No B outcomes from the new cohort were used for this review.
All three added entries have measurable directions; the BF8 discovery procedure is unchanged and only its usage/outcomes metadata differ. The treatment is the full entry objects, not isolated prose.
V1 is deliberately limited to identifying diagnostics in terminated quote-guard blocks. S1 tests final acceptance and does not establish every earlier mutation was staged.

D0-D3 require actual candidate and assignment evidence, not model allegations. Counts are once per entity-field group; D1 <= D0 and D3 <= D2 <= D0 follow from the definitions. Unknown evidence is N/A; zero exposure makes conditional counts N/A.

F1 requires an exact failed return in a research extraction/verification source payload, excludes failure diagnosis/refinement/instruction-only mentions, and counts each subcall once. It is not the failure count or proof of recovery.
R2 requires executed later-block evidence use, not same-block extraction or printing only a saved length; source completeness and block granularity affect opportunity.

Fetch requests, failure reasons, repeats, cache/shared states, raw HTTP-body artifacts, ordinary per-URL fetched characters and additional whole-text hash deduplication remain separately reportable. Root size uses the largest root; overlap uses the union of all roots.

Every automatic and additional manual metric is reported, with raw observations and explicit N/A reasons; arbitrary nonnegative integer manual counts fit the existing helper. Automatic ratios use the existing numeric path.

Strict absolute mean delta > maximum within-arm range is descriptive. Equality fails the criterion; N/A is not zero; fewer than three defined runs requires qualification. Three repeats are not statistical evidence.

Mechanical quote/identity checks and model audit allegations do not replace all-cell semantic review. Saved replay entries are not claimed to seed these arms. Cross-round fetch-path changes do not isolate learning.
